editions.name: Florida Beatbox Battle 2020
editions.format_note: Pe4enkata could not attend, so the audience acted as the 5th judge.

solo.format_note: Quarterfinals were a round robin: each beatboxer battled two opponents, two wins advanced, two losses meant elimination, and 1-1 records went to a tiebreaker.
notes: FootboxG, PACMax, B-Art & K.I.M. acted as replacements of [pt] MixFX (1st Wildcard Winner), [sg] Piratheeban (3rd Wildcard Winner), [ma] Double-M (4th Wildcard Winner) and [co] Beatmeda (2019 3rd Wilcard Winner).
[nl] Jarno Ibarra was invited as a replacement but was unable to participate.
